photos.desc: Slunka obecná , ( Leucaspius delineatus ) na výstavě Pod hladinou Vltavy, Palác Kinských , Staroměstské náměstí , Praha 2011
Young specimen of Leucaspius delineatus beyond the water; found dead, about 3 cm in length. The eye has a diameter of slightly more than 2 mm.
This bulldoglike appearance is typical for Leucaspius delineatus , and is in sharp contrast to the head of the similar bleak Alburnus alburnus , Hoensbroek, the Netherlands
